narration:0:1360001001:1.text: After a long time, you receive a letter from Atalanta inviting you to visit the Remnant Peaks...
narration:0:1360001001:1.source_cn: 久违地，你们收到了阿塔兰忒的信，信中邀请你们前去遗迹群山……

say:3:1360001002:1.text: Ah, the Remnant Peaks! It's been forever since we were here.
say:3:1360001002:1.source_cn: 啊，遗迹群山！好久没回来了，感觉真怀念！

say:4:1360001003:1.text: It really has been ages. If it weren't for Atalanta's invitation...
say:4:1360001003:1.source_cn: 是呀，感觉真的很长时间了，要不是阿塔兰忒写信邀请我们过来……

say:5:1360001004:1.text: Ah, Atalanta! Over Here! We made it, just like you asked!
say:5:1360001004:1.source_cn: 啊！阿塔兰忒！这边！我们应邀来了！

say:7:1360001005:1.text: Hey, Magister! And my two favorite little hamsters! Long time no see! How's life treating you?
say:7:1360001005:1.source_cn: 嘿！魔法师，两个小仓鼠，久违了！最近过得怎么样？

say:8:1360001006:1.text: Couldn't be better! What about you? What made you reach out all of a sudden? And—
say:8:1360001006:1.source_cn: 一切都非常完美！阿塔兰忒，你呢？怎么突然写信过来？
say:8:1360001006:1.male: Couldn't be better! What about you? What made you reach out all of a sudden? And—
say:8:1360001006:1.female: Couldn't be better! What about you? What made you reach out all of a sudden? And—

say:9:1360001007:1.text: Whoa, slow down with the questions! First off, I've been great—better than great. I've been basking in something I've missed for way too long: freedom!
say:9:1360001007:1.source_cn: 啊，让我一个个回答吧。第一，我过得非常好！确切地说，我...

choice_prompt:10:1360001007.text: Whoa, slow down with the questions! First off, I've been great—better than great. I've been basking in something I've missed for way too long: freedom!
choice_prompt:10:1360001007.source_cn: 啊，让我一个个回答吧。第一，我过得非常好！确切地说，我获得了久违的自由自在的时光！

say:12:1360001008:1.text: Exactly! Glorious, blissful freedom. Sleeping in, staying up late, going where the wind takes me.
say:12:1360001008:1.source_cn: 没错！专属于我自己的，自由又快乐，想睡就睡想起就起的日子！
say:12:1360001008:1.male: Exactly! Glorious, blissful freedom. Sleeping in, staying up late, going where the wind takes me.
say:12:1360001008:1.female: Exactly! Glorious, blissful freedom. Sleeping in, staying up late, going where the wind takes me.

say:13:1360001010:1.text: Not that there's anything wrong with my dear companion, but you know, everyone needs a little space now and then.
say:13:1360001010:1.source_cn: 虽然不是说我亲爱的旅伴有什么问题，但人偶尔还是想要有点...
say:13:1360001010:1.male: Not that there's anything wrong with my dear companion, but you know, everyone needs a little space now and then.
say:13:1360001010:1.female: Not that there's anything wrong with my dear companion, but you know, everyone needs a little space now and then.

say:14:1360001011:1.text: So while she's off at the temple filing a report, I may have snuck out and taken on a side job just for fun.
say:14:1360001011:1.source_cn: 所以，我趁着她回圣堂述职的时间偷偷接了个委托，然后出来...
say:14:1360001011:1.male: So while she's off at the temple filing a report, I may have snuck out and taken on a side job just for fun.
say:14:1360001011:1.female: So while she's off at the temple filing a report, I may have snuck out and taken on a side job just for fun.

say:16:1360001012:0.text: A side job? Atalanta, please tell me you're not skirting the edges of the law again...
say:16:1360001012:0.source_cn: 私活……阿塔兰忒，你该不会又去做什么在违法边缘的事情了吧……

say:17:1360001013:0.text: Hah! Who, me? Of course not! Well... not this time. It's all legit, I promise! I've been working with the Evergreen Conservatory.
say:17:1360001013:0.source_cn: 啊哈哈哈哈，那可说不准——不过这次倒还真没有，是冬青学...

say:18:1360001014:1.text: They hired me to poke around some ruins—fiddle with ancient mechanisms, decode magical runes, disable a few traps. I even sent you a copy of some runes I found!
say:18:1360001014:1.source_cn: 我之前跟着他们去了个遗迹，帮他们破解了不少机关，也抄了...
say:18:1360001014:1.male: They hired me to poke around some ruins—fiddle with ancient mechanisms, decode magical runes, disable a few traps. I even sent you a copy of some runes I found!
say:18:1360001014:1.female: They hired me to poke around some ruins—fiddle with ancient mechanisms, decode magical runes, disable a few traps. I even sent you a copy of some runes I found!

choice_prompt:19:1360001014.text: They hired me to poke around some ruins—fiddle with ancient mechanisms, decode magical runes, disable a few traps. I even sent you a copy of some runes I found!
choice_prompt:19:1360001014.source_cn: 我之前跟着他们去了个遗迹，帮他们破解了不少机关，也抄了一些符文给你，你应该收到了吧？
choice_prompt:19:1360001014.male: They hired me to poke around some ruins—fiddle with ancient mechanisms, decode magical runes, disable a few traps. I even sent you a copy of some runes I found!
choice_prompt:19:1360001014.female: They hired me to poke around some ruins—fiddle with ancient mechanisms, decode magical runes, disable a few traps. I even sent you a copy of some runes I found!

say:20:1360001015:0.text: Don't tell me you didn't get it! They asked me to help decode some crazy magical inscriptions and disable a few traps.
say:20:1360001015:0.source_cn: 差不多两个月前寄给你的一封问候，可别说你没收到！冬青学...
say:20:1360001015:0.male: Don't tell me you didn't get it! They asked me to help decode some crazy magical inscriptions and disable a few traps.
say:20:1360001015:0.female: Don't tell me you didn't get it! They asked me to help decode some crazy magical inscriptions and disable a few traps.

say:21:1360001018:1.text: Anyway, after that gig, the Evergreen Conservatory was so impressed they rehired me. But this time, I didn't work for free!
say:21:1360001018:1.source_cn: 那次之后冬青学会尝到了甜头，又邀请了我一次。但这次我可...
say:21:1360001018:1.male: Anyway, after that gig, the Evergreen Conservatory was so impressed they rehired me. But this time, I didn't work for free!
say:21:1360001018:1.female: Anyway, after that gig, the Evergreen Conservatory was so impressed they rehired me. But this time, I didn't work for free!

say:22:1360001019:1.text: Here, check out what they paid me with. I have no use for it, so I'm giving it to you.
say:22:1360001019:1.source_cn: 看，这是他们的报酬。我用不上，给你们好了。

say:23:1360001020:1.text: This... it feels familiar. Like it's hiding a whole world inside...
say:23:1360001020:1.source_cn: 这是……我记得之前好像见过类似的魔法道具，里面蕴藏着奇...

say:24:1360001021:1.text: I have no idea what it does. The scholars couldn't figure it out either. Since it doesn't seem historically important, they let me keep it!
say:24:1360001021:1.source_cn: 具体有什么用我也不知道啦，那些学者们研究不明白，看起来...

say:25:1360001022:1.text: And now, I'm passing it to you—call it a reunion gift. Oh, and to celebrate my newfound freedom, of course.
say:25:1360001022:1.source_cn: 而我就决定把这个送给你，当做久别重逢以及自由的礼物！
say:25:1360001022:1.male: And now, I'm passing it to you—call it a reunion gift. Oh, and to celebrate my newfound freedom, of course.
say:25:1360001022:1.female: And now, I'm passing it to you—call it a reunion gift. Oh, and to celebrate my newfound freedom, of course.

choice_prompt:26:1360001022.text: And now, I'm passing it to you—call it a reunion gift. Oh, and to celebrate my newfound freedom, of course.
choice_prompt:26:1360001022.source_cn: 而我就决定把这个送给你，当做久别重逢以及自由的礼物！
choice_prompt:26:1360001022.male: And now, I'm passing it to you—call it a reunion gift. Oh, and to celebrate my newfound freedom, of course.
choice_prompt:26:1360001022.female: And now, I'm passing it to you—call it a reunion gift. Oh, and to celebrate my newfound freedom, of course.

say:27:1360001023:1.text: Hold on! This gift comes with one condition. You can't tell anyone where I am. I need a few more days to enjoy my break before Temesia tracks me down!
say:27:1360001023:1.source_cn: 这礼物可不是白送的！你要记得，可别说漏嘴告诉别人我的去...
say:27:1360001023:1.male: Hold on! This gift comes with one condition. You can't tell anyone where I am. I need a few more days to enjoy my break before Temesia tracks me down!
say:27:1360001023:1.female: Hold on! This gift comes with one condition. You can't tell anyone where I am. I need a few more days to enjoy my break before Temesia tracks me down!

say:28:1360001025:1.text: Don't worry, I'll wander around a bit longer, then head back and play nice. Just... keep my little adventure a secret, okay?
say:28:1360001025:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我再随便逛几天，就会回去老实做人，这几天你们要...

say:30:1360001026:1.text: The sound of laughter fills the air as you trade jokes, but the moment is cut short by something strange appearing out of nowhere...
say:30:1360001026:1.source_cn: 正在说笑的时候，突然，眼前出现了一个奇怪的东西……

say:32:1360001027:1.text: It looks like a sack at first glance, but it wobbles slightly, and the distinct jingle of coins echoes with each movement.
say:32:1360001027:1.source_cn: 乍一看像是个布袋，但里面满满当当地装满了金属钱币，稍微...

say:33:1360001028:0.text: Is that... a coin satchel? Alive?! Is it a monster?

say:34:1360001029:1.text: Oh! Can I take the coins inside? This is amazing!
say:34:1360001029:1.source_cn: 里面的钱可以拿的吗？！太棒了吧？！

say:36:1360001024:1.text: Hehe, don't be silly! I trust you. You wouldn't rat me out anyway, right?
say:36:1360001024:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，怎么会呢，我相信你，就算我不送这个，你也不会把我...
say:36:1360001024:1.male: Hehe, don't be silly! I trust you. You wouldn't rat me out anyway, right?
say:36:1360001024:1.female: Hehe, don't be silly! I trust you. You wouldn't rat me out anyway, right?

say:37:1360001016:1.text: "Gift code"? Is that mage slang for something? Anyway, they said the runes were said to be specially designed for mages like you, so I hope you made good use of them!
say:37:1360001016:1.source_cn: 收到就好，据说那是你们魔法师专用的特殊符文，能兑换什么...
say:37:1360001016:1.male: "Gift code"? Is that mage slang for something? Anyway, they said the runes were said to be specially designed for mages like you, so I hope you made good use of them!
say:37:1360001016:1.female: "Gift code"? Is that mage slang for something? Anyway, they said the runes were said to be specially designed for mages like you, so I hope you made good use of them!

say:38:1360001017:1.text: Seriously? I put my blood, sweat, and tears into copying those runes, and you're telling me they weren't helpful?
say:38:1360001017:1.source_cn: 那是用于兑换奖励的符文，只能用一次，只有你们魔法师才能...
say:38:1360001017:1.male: Seriously? I put my blood, sweat, and tears into copying those runes, and you're telling me they weren't helpful?
say:38:1360001017:1.female: Seriously? I put my blood, sweat, and tears into copying those runes, and you're telling me they weren't helpful?

say:40:1360001009:1.text: Oh, she's fine. Same as ever—early to bed, early to rise, prayers ticking like clockwork. Honestly, she's steady as a rock.
say:40:1360001009:1.source_cn: 她好着呢，每天早睡早起，定时祈祷，一如既往地规律而又无聊。
say:40:1360001009:1.male: Oh, she's fine. Same as ever—early to bed, early to rise, prayers ticking like clockwork. Honestly, she's steady as a rock.
say:40:1360001009:1.female: Oh, she's fine. Same as ever—early to bed, early to rise, prayers ticking like clockwork. Honestly, she's steady as a rock.
